direction: Medieval rough fibrous drawing sheet with genuinely frayed edges. User rejected online textures, formal metallic framing and the preceding neat scroll curls.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production material asset: ONE complete broad blank medieval working drawing sheet, front-on, 4:3 ratio around 1448x1086 pixels, isolated with TRUE TRANSPARENT exterior. The user rejected smooth rolled parchment and formal ornate gold UI frames: the sheet must feel visibly ROUGH, HANDMADE, FIBROUS and WORN, like an authentic medieval surveyor/alchemist's sheepskin drawing kept in a leather satchel. Reference image is only our earlier warm parchment colour palette; intensify its tangible material rather than its rectangular neatness. Broad irregular DECKLE EDGES, dry abraded frayed fibres, fuzzy wisps and thin delaminated layers along all four sides, feathered pale torn lips, a few small missing edge flecks, rubbed/scuffed corners, subtle wrinkles, several old pressed fold scars and varied skin/paper fibre thickness. Rich fine tactile photographic-painterly detail at the margins. Warm ivory central field with warm buff / sepia edges, muted walnut shadows, never bright orange or grungy black. The central 80% must remain continuous, opaque, light and readable for real scientific graphics that the application will draw afterwards; fine irregular fibres and faint uneven compression wrinkles remain visible across it. Perimeter 4-6% can be more aged and visibly furry. All sheet corners and frayed strands fully inside canvas with 1% transparent margin. Flat material with gentle grazing illumination, no external ground or cast shadow, no room, no perspective tilt. ABSOLUTELY NO lettering, map markings, glyphs, numbers, diagrams, faux handwriting, border linework, gold or metal mouldings, floral frame, stitched leather surrounding it, cylindrical scroll rollers or tidy curled corner tabs. This is an actual rough-edged medieval drawing sheet, NOT a border assembly, NOT a museum frame, NOT four separate sprites. Preserve large uninterrupted rectangular working area, organic irregular silhouette.
reuse: crafted-leather.png is the original earlier generated candidate, now restored; scroll-control-skins.png supplies native control backgrounds
retired: brown-leather-cc0.jpg, crafted-gold-binding.png, crafted-control-skins.png are retained as historical sources but no longer embedded or loaded; scroll-vellum-binding.png is a rejected candidate, never embedded.
